title: Junta Gyrocopters Bomb Kanyin Village, Ayadaw Township — Pregnant Woman Among Dead
detail: Military airstrikes across Sagaing and Magway Regions killed at least 4 civilians and injured roughly 9 others on July 13-14, 2026. On July 14, three gyrocopters (light attack aircraft) launched from Monywa's Northwestern Regional Military Command bombed Kanyin village, Ayadaw Township, Sagaing Region, killing a pregnant woman (and her unborn child) and another woman, and critically injuring one man.

media.caption: Junta gyrocopters bomb Kanyin village, Ayadaw Township, killing a pregnant woman.

title: Junta Airstrikes on Karenni and Northern Shan States Kill At Least 12
detail: Two separate junta airstrikes killed at least 12 people on July 14, 2026: an afternoon airstrike on Kyaukme, a TNLA-controlled town in northern Shan State, killed 5 people, while an airstrike near a mining site in Hpasawng Township, Karenni (Kayah) State, killed at least 7. Separately, three junta aircraft dropped 14 bombs across three locations in eastern Loikaw Township — two IDP camps and one civilian village — at around 5:00pm, killing a 50-year-old displaced woman with shrapnel and destroying multiple houses and vehicles; no prior clashes were reported in the area, indicating direct targeting of civilian and IDP sites.

media.caption: Junta airstrikes target IDP camps in eastern Loikaw, Karenni State, killing a displaced woman.
